text:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-metering-heartbeat (eu1) — token-count drift > 12% over 5m. Triggered at 03:22 UTC. Links: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/9876
ana_oncall: I'm on it, taking pager :wave:
matt_dev: looking at emitter logs now — seeing a burst of duplicate emits from proxy-queue on eu1, looks like retry storm after brief kafka lag
sophia_billing: early peek: 12 accounts got overage flags; billing pipeline emitted charge notifications for those windows. Holding off customer emails until we confirm
lee_sre: do we have a quick dedupe toggle? we should stop forward notifications and mute ratecap alerts
matt_dev: can toggle 'emitter.dedupe=true' at runtime for the eu cluster. Doing a quick dry run.

matt_dev: run:
```
# set dedupe on emitter fleet (eu1)
kubectl -n svc patch deploy/emitter-eu --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"EMITTER_DEDUPE","value":"true"}}]'
```

matt_dev: logs after toggle:
```
[2026-02-12T03:25:10Z] emitter: dedupe=enabled
[2026-02-12T03:25:12Z] emitter: suppressed duplicate message id=xyz123 count=4
```

incident-bot: Alert update: token-count drift reduced from 12.8% -> 1.9% (5m avg). Severity auto-updated to P2
ana_oncall: paused external webhook notify and suppressed outbound charge-notify topic :white_check_mark:
sophia_billing: creating short customer advisory draft, holding send until recon complete. Also opening a temporary credit hold for the 12 accounts pending recon
customer-ops: will prepare CS script and put on standby for any incoming tickets. ETA to post-mortem note?
lee_sre: root-cause hypothesis: transient kafka consumer lag + emitter retry logic lacked idempotency header for a subset of messages. Need postmortem and a long-term fix (ensure idempotency header + broker-side dedupe)
matt_dev: filed bug: RDW-INC-2026-2017, will own follow-up. Plan: add idempotency header, add consumer-side offset guard, and improve emitter metrics
sophia_billing: running a reconcile job to compute exact delta and reversal candidates. Backfill plan in progress.
ana_oncall: handing to billing-eng for the post-incident runbook. Leaving a short note in #incidents/docs. Thanks all :pray:
customer-ops: tagging impacted customers draft -> will wait for billing sign-off before sending
incident-bot: Incident closed: mitigation confirmed, followups assigned. Auto-generated task: INC-2026-2017 (billing-emitter-idempotency).
